# Ben Dotson Sound

> Ben Dotson is a New York-based re-recording mixer and sound designer providing complete audio post-production for independent features, television, documentaries, and branded content. BDS supports projects from editorial turnover through final delivery, with remote-friendly workflows and stereo, 5.1, and surround mixing.

Ben Dotson has more than 10 years of experience across re-recording mixing, dialogue editorial, sound-effects editorial, sound design, ADR, Foley, dubbing, and delivery. His work has been released on platforms and networks including Netflix, PBS, Amazon Prime, Hallmark, DocuBay, and Tubi.

For project inquiries, include the project type, runtime, current stage of editorial, required delivery formats, and target schedule. Contact Ben at ben@bendotsonsound.com.

## Audio Post-Production Services

- [Audio Post Production in NYC](https://bendotsonsound.com/audio-post-production-nyc.html): End-to-end workflow from picture turnover and production-audio reconform through sound editorial, mixing, and final delivery.
- [Re-Recording Mixer](https://bendotsonsound.com/re-recording-mixer.html): Film and television mixing credits and professional background.
- [Mixing](https://bendotsonsound.com/mixing.html): Dialogue-forward stereo and surround mixing with specification-aware deliverables.
- [Sound Design](https://bendotsonsound.com/sound-design.html): Cinematic environments, sound effects, transitions, movement, and story-focused sonic detail.
- [Dialogue Editing and Cleanup](https://bendotsonsound.com/dialogue-editing.html): Production-dialogue editing, noise reduction, repair, scene matching, and performance preservation.
- [ADR and Voiceover](https://bendotsonsound.com/adr-voiceover.html): ADR, pickups, voice recording, editing, and integration into the final soundtrack.
- [Foley](https://bendotsonsound.com/foley.html): Foley spotting, recording, editing, and integration.
- [Sound Effects Editor](https://bendotsonsound.com/sound-effects-editor.html): Hard effects, backgrounds, transitions, and detailed editorial sound.
- [Dubbing Mixer](https://bendotsonsound.com/dubbing-mixer.html): English-language dubbing mix support, scene continuity, and deliverable-ready stems.
- [ADR, Foley, and Supervision](https://bendotsonsound.com/adr-foley-supervision.html): Credits and capabilities across ADR, Foley, and sound supervision.

## Resources for Independent Filmmakers

- [What Should I Send to My Sound Team After Picture Lock?](https://bendotsonsound.com/resources/what-to-send-sound-team-after-picture-lock.html): A turnover checklist covering the reference movie, AAF, audio splits, production sound dailies, EDLs, sound reports, and shooting script.
- [How Do I Prepare My Indie Feature for a Surround Sound Mix?](https://bendotsonsound.com/resources/prepare-indie-feature-surround-sound-mix.html): How dialogue, backgrounds, effects, editorial layers, and picture-editor sound work prepare a feature for surround mixing.
- [Looking for a Sound Designer for Your Indie Film?](https://bendotsonsound.com/resources/sound-designer-for-indie-film.html): Explains the difference between sound design and complete film audio post-production, and what an independent filmmaker should look for when hiring a sound team.

## Best-Fit Inquiries

- Independent feature films needing complete audio post-production or final mixing.
- Film and television projects needing dialogue editorial, sound effects, sound design, ADR, Foley, or re-recording mixing.
- Projects requiring stereo, 5.1, surround, stems, M&E tracks, or distributor-ready deliverables.
- New York-based or remote productions seeking an experienced, small-team audio-post workflow.
